patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: I woke up gasping like I was drowning — I can't breathe lying down at all, I have to sit bolt upright. I'm coughing up frothy spit and my heart's pounding. Came on fast tonight.
presentation.triageNote: 72-year-old male who woke suddenly gasping and cannot tolerate lying flat. He has frothy sputum and diffuse crackles; blood pressure is 212/118, respiratory rate 32, and oxygen saturation 85%.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 1 is appropriate because oxygen saturation 85%, respiratory rate 32, frothy sputum, and inability to lie flat require immediate noninvasive ventilatory support and aggressive afterload reduction.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient has severe hypertensive pulmonary edema with acute gas-exchange failure and marked respiratory distress.
clinical.acuityReason: Profound hypoxemia and work of breathing require immediate lifesaving respiratory intervention while blood pressure is treated.
expectedResources: Cardiac monitoring, ECG, and IV access
Chest imaging and cardiac laboratory testing
teachingPoints: Rapid positive-pressure support and afterload reduction can reverse this physiology quickly.
Fatigue, worsening mental status, or failure of noninvasive support may require intubation.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Immediate ventilatory and blood-pressure treatment would be followed by intensive cardiac evaluation and admission.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: bolt upright, gripping the chair, gasping
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a black 72-year-old man, sweaty and struggling, sitting bolt upright on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: bolt upright, gripping the chair arms, gasping for air. Expression: panicked and air-hungry. Clearly visible: a rigid upright posture, white-knuckle grip, and gasping effort. No text, no logos.
